segments.oily: Reviewers with an oily zone or oily skin report the product removes sebum and residue from the T-zone and nose without leaving an oily film, though one with a mixed oily/sensitive zone found it stripping and burning.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it as hydrating and non-stripping, useful even in winter when skin is extra dry, and one says it improved dryness over time.
segments.sensitive: Reports are split: some sensitive-skin reviewers use it with no problems and even see calming of redness or blackheads, while others describe burning, tightness, itching, or irritation that took about a week to resolve, and one suspects an allergic reaction.
segments.combination: One reviewer describes normal-to-oily combination skin and found the cleanser stripping with a burning sensation.

concerns.aging: One reviewer combining this with acids and a retinoid hopes for anti-aging benefits but does not yet report a visible result.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cleanser as non-drying and hydrating, with several noting improved dryness or comfort after use; one sensitive-skin reviewer nonetheless found it sometimes drying, and one reported stripped, burning skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports visibly less redness after first use; another describes irritation and redness-like tightness and itching that took about a week to calm down.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say the product cleanses without compromising the skin's moisture or comfort, but a few report burning, itching, or prolonged irritation suggesting barrier disruption for their skin.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers, including some using it for teenagers, report a visible reduction in blackheads and smaller-looking pores within about two weeks; no dissent on this point.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report clearer, breakout-free skin or improvement with acne after continued use; no negative reports specific to breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the cleanser as removing excess sebum and surface oil (including sunscreen and sweat) without leaving a greasy residue.

aspects.libelle: Causes burning or stinging on use

extraits.texte: I have an oily zone but the rest of my skin is pretty normal, a little sensitive. I was excited to try this, Unfortunately this oil cleanser wasn't for me, it made my face feel stripped and had a burning sensation after using.

extraits.titre: Cleans well, but not good for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: Skin is very soft after first use, but after the second day my skin started to feel tight, itchy and became very irritated. It took a week to calm down. I really wanted to like this product so I tried again and the same thing happened after the second day. I fear I may be allergic to one of the ingredients. It may work for people who do not have sensitive skin.
I used this for the 1st time last night and In the morning I can see the lightness of my redness from rosacea!!! This is my 1st time using Azelaic Acid and I am impressed!!

extraits.titre: Best cleansing oil on the market!
extraits.texte: If you have a teenager who is struggling with blackheads, you might want to have them try adding this to their daily/nightly skincare routine. Even if all they do is wash and moisturize, this will be the one step that will help unclog everything. DRY hands, DRY face, less than half a pump is all you need!! Really work it in, as though it were face soap, paying special attention to t-zone and nose. My teens do this step right before getting in the shower.

I have dry and sensitive skin, but I haven't found any problems with this cleanser! I love how clean my face feels after using it, and i have started to notice a reduction in blackheads around my nose and chin!
Not my favorite smell on a product, but definitely not bad, either. Love the texture and cleansing, face is clear, breakout-free, and comfortable. Good price for the product.
